lines.text: An Exploration of Music Evolution Based on Inﬂuencer
Network and Cosine Similarity
Summary
Aiming to comprehend the evolution of music, we combine the network science,
cosine similarity, Cooling Model and Gravity Model in physics, as well as other sta-
tistical methods to explore how music evolves through inﬂuence across artists and
genres.
